headline: Colombia opens embassy in Jerusalem, restores free trade deal with Israel
summary: Colombia opened its embassy in Jerusalem, becoming the 10th government to do so, after President Abelardo De La Espriella reversed his predecessor's break with Israel. The free trade deal with Israel was also restored.
why: Free trade agreements set tariff and market-access terms for bilateral trade, and diplomatic ties shape investment and political risk.
